draft.subject: client data and the SRA
draft.body:
Hi Claire,

A different angle this time. The SRA warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.

Is putting those safeguards in place something Fernhill & Doyle is working through?
